name: light-workspace
description: The light repository: @bootstrapp/light in packages/light, the workspace packages native apps share, the examples, the benchmarks and the website.

scripts.check: npm run check:root && npm --prefix packages/light run check
scripts.bake:tasks: node packages/light/bin/light.js classes:bake examples/tasks/main.js -o examples/tasks/classes.baked.js --scheme dark,light
scripts.verify:packages: npm run packages:check && npm run packages:typecheck && npm run packages:test && npm run packages:coverage
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:root && npm --prefix packages/light run verify && npm run coverage:tasks && npm run bake:tasks -- --check && npm run verify:packages
